en: I love that Havayah hears my voice, my supplications.
For He inclined His ear to me, and in my days I shall call.

he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי ׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
en: The pangs of death encompassed me, and the straits of Sheol found me; trouble and sorrow I found.

he: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
en: And in the name of Havayah I shall call: Please, Havayah, deliver my soul.
Gracious is Havayah and righteous, and our Elokim is merciful.

he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
en: Havayah guards the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
en: Return, my soul, to your rest, for Havayah has dealt bountifully with you.

he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
en: For You delivered my soul from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
I shall walk before Havayah in the lands of the living.

he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
en: I believed when I spoke; I was very afflicted.
I said in my haste: All men are liars.
What shall I return to Havayah — all His bounties upon me?
The cup of salvations I shall lift, and in the name of Havayah I shall call.
My vows to Havayah I shall pay, in the presence now of all His people.
Precious in the eyes of Havayah is the death of His devoted ones.

he: אָנָּ֣ה יְהֹוָה֮ כִּי־אֲנִ֢י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמֽוֹסֵרָֽי׃
en: Please, Havayah, for I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You loosened my bonds.

he: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
en: To You I shall sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and in the name of Havayah I shall call.
My vows to Havayah I shall pay, in the presence now of all His people.

he: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת ׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
en: In the courtyards of the house of Havayah, in your midst, Yerushalayim: Hallelukah.
